scope: Local code and disposable loopback PostgreSQL only; no production/staging access or deployment.

incrementalBaseline.description: Snapshot of the uncommitted implementation described by the previous local November 10 section, before the unified role catalog and direct service-interval read.

candidate.description: Working tree after the unified role catalog and direct service-interval read.

method: Five paired uncached service calculations per scenario and mode, alternating source order on identical data within each comparison. Warm database pages; cold samples use fresh Node/Prisma processes. Calculation timings exclude process boot and module imports. After-session is one prior SELECT, not HTTP authentication. Complete serialized results, including Map and Set, were compared in every pair. SQL profiles and EXPLAIN ANALYZE replays are separate extra instrumented calls after timed samples. Pool durations overlap and include queue/event-loop delay. SQL replays are not timings of the original server execution. Profiles retain all Prisma operations and the relevant SQL plans; sqlStatementCount counts all captured SQL, including plans omitted here. Three separate-process initialization diagnostics per source do not warm timed samples; their module-import timing starts after diagnostic dependencies load. JSON sizes are not network traffic.
changes: Read base-model and role cost parameters as one catalog, attaching profiles by role ID while retaining date/version resolution.
Read non-RDO service intervals directly by period and report visibility, preserving the parent query/order and the nominal historical evidence.

limitations: The thin incremental fresh-process median increased by 3.8 percent; latency gains are not uniform.
Versus the original commit, fresh-process medians improved by 40.6 percent (thin) and 50.1 percent (dense). The latter is near the threshold; all-target 50-percent and HTTP acceptance remain pending.
Synthetic local service measurements, not production HTTP p50/p95, LCP or authenticated browser performance.
No new index was justified by the local query plans. Other relation bindings and historical/global source reduction remain candidates for measurement.
The next local implementation stage is an authenticated concurrent HTTP scenario for cards, groups and point data, separating first response and refresh.
Published 24-hour/seven-day and permission/volume acceptance, retention policy/application remain pending. Backups are deferred and unchanged.
